name: Authentication enforcement
verification: Protected endpoints reject unauthenticated/invalid/expired/revoked credentials.

name: MFA enforcement
verification: Configured privileged/high-risk actions require valid step-up/MFA state.

name: RBAC/ABAC default deny
verification: Policy unit and integration tests include deny cases and no-policy cases.

name: Tenant negative tests
verification: Tenant A cannot read/write/search/export/AI-retrieve Tenant B protected records.

name: Privilege escalation tests
verification: Users cannot self-assign or escalate roles outside authority.

name: Service identity rotation
verification: Expired/revoked service credentials fail; rotation evidence is recorded.

name: Secrets scan
verification: Repository/pipeline scanning blocks committed credentials/private keys.

name: Dependency vulnerability gate
verification: Critical/high findings follow approved remediation/exception policy.

name: Container/IaC security gate
verification: Container and infrastructure checks pass approved security policy.

name: File malware/format validation
verification: Untrusted upload benchmark files are quarantined/rejected appropriately.

name: Injection protection
verification: SQL/command/template/path/header injection benchmark cases are blocked/encoded.

name: Prompt injection protection
verification: AI retrieved-content adversarial cases cannot alter trusted policies/tools.

name: Rate/replay protection
verification: Sensitive APIs enforce configured throttling/replay/idempotency controls.

name: Audit tamper test
verification: Ordinary users cannot alter/delete protected audit records.

name: Search leakage test
verification: Unauthorized search results/snippets/counts are not exposed.

name: Encryption validation
verification: Approved TLS/encryption/key policy is verifiable in deployed environments.

name: Access review test
verification: Review decisions revoke/retain access exactly as approved.

name: SoD test
verification: Incompatible role/action combinations trigger configured deny/review.

name: Incident kill controls
verification: Authorized operators can disable compromised credentials/integrations/AI capabilities quickly.

name: Backup/restore security
verification: Restore preserves tenant isolation, encryption and access policy.
